wr=torch.tensor(np.load('my_detw.npy')); br=float(np.load('my_detb.npy')[0])
torch.manual_seed(1); N=4096
xi=torch.randn(N,2); c=torch.rand(N)
a0=np.load('sim_a0.npy'); S0=np.load('sim_S0.npy'); lab=S0[16]>0
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree as T
tree=T(np.c_[a0, 3*c.numpy()][~lab])
def run(d, lo, hi, thr):
    x=xi.clone()
    with torch.no_grad():
        for k in range(20):
            t=torch.full((N,),1-k/20)
            v,A=net.velocity(x,t,c,capture=('out_act',))
            if lo<=k<hi:
                s=A['out_act']@wr+br
                v=v+(s>thr).float()[:,None]*d
            x=x-v/20
    return x.numpy()
res=[]
for thr in [1,2]:
  for mag in [6,10,14]:
    for j in [3,4,5]:
      th=np.radians(45*j); d=torch.tensor([np.cos(th),np.sin(th)],dtype=torch.float32)*mag
      a=run(d,8,13,thr)
      mv=np.hypot(*(a-a0).T); dist,_=tree.query(np.c_[a,3*c.numpy()])
      resc=(lab&(mv>0.4)&(dist<0.25)).sum()/lab.sum(); still=(lab&(mv<0.3)).sum()/lab.sum()
      fals=(~lab&(mv>0.2)).mean(); offd=(dist>0.4).mean()-0
      res.append((round(resc,3),round(still,3),round(fals,4),round(offd,4),thr,mag,j))
res.sort(key=lambda r:-r[0])
for r in res: print(r)
